name: phugoid
description: Fixed-wing flight-mode lab in EigenScript — textbook aerodynamic modes as an external oracle for observer semantics, built oracle-first (rung 0: derivative tables, mode predictions, and planted-fault-validated measurement scripts). Rungs 1-3 ship the longitudinal and lateral 3-DOF models and a closed-loop autopilot, each graded against predictions computed before it existed.
